stories.title: Peralta tosses gem, Rays cash in on Ramirez's gaffe in Game 2 win
stories.summary: Freddy Peralta threw six scoreless innings and Liam Hicks took advantage of a fielding error by Jose Ramirez with a 2-run single as the Rays took Game 2.

stories.title: 'Adamant' Ohtani will be in Dodgers' Game 3 NLCS lineup, Roberts says
stories.summary: Los Angeles Dodgers manager Dave Roberts told reporters Tuesday that struggling superstar Shohei Ohtani will be in the lineup for Game 3 of the NLCS on Wednesday vs. the Milwaukee Brewers.

stories.title: Hill found liable for 2 counts of battery in mixed verdict; wife awarded $500K
stories.summary: A Miami jury returned a mixed verdict in the assault and battery civil trial against Tyreek Hill, finding the former NFL receiver liable for two counts of battery but not liable for the eight other claims made by his estranged wife, Lakeeta Vaccaro.

stories.title: NFL suspends Rams LT Jackson two games for punch after Bills game
stories.summary: The NFL on Tuesday suspended Rams left tackle Alaric Jackson for two games without pay after he punched Bills outside linebacker Bradley Chubb following Monday night's game in Los Angeles.

stories.title: Parsons: 'Daniels probably cost my man Dan Quinn his job' with Commanders
stories.summary: Micah Parsons said on his podcast that Jayden Daniels' mistake at the end of overtime Sunday will probably end up getting Commanders coach Dan Quinn fired.
